BrochureContent.Content:
129 Griffith Avenue is a wonderful five bedroomed period house with an additional attic room; self-contained ancillary accommodation to the rear and a double garage. Built c.1929 this impressive home has been in the same family since being built and is being offered for sale for the first time in almost a century. There is additional convenient on-street parking available to the front. The house occupies a large, elevated site on one of Dublin's most beautiful tree lined residential avenues. A lush lawn and pathway lead you to a most attractive period facade with a bay window at both ground and first floor level, granite sills and lintels, red brick detail and an apex roof feature. The accommodation extends to 139sqm (including the self contained accommodation but excluding the attic) comprising three reception rooms, a kitchen and WC at ground floor level. There are four bedrooms ( 3 double and 1 single) an en suite shower room and a bathroom on the first floor. A permanent staircase leads to a large attic room ( 10sqm) with a good ceiling height and storage. 
The ancillary accommodation measures 10sqm and is accessed from the rear garden and comprises a kitchen/living room, bedroom and shower room with electric heating. There is an external utility outhouse .The rear garden extends to 30m from the rear elevation of the house to the garage. The double garage measures 25sqm has two up and over doors opening into the rear laneway. 
Griffith Avenue is one of Dublin's most admired residential addresses; a wide, double tree-lined boulevard stretching across three electoral constituencies and famed for its quiet elegance and architectural charm. With no commercial premises along its length, it offers peaceful, residential living just minutes from the city centre.
This location is ideal for families and commuters alike. It's within walking distance of Drumcondra Village, with its vibrant mix of independent shops, cafés, restaurants and delicatessens. An excellent selection of primary and secondary schools is nearby, including Corpus Christi, St. Pat's, Dominican College, Maryfield College, and Ard Scoil Rís. Dublin City University is also within easy reach.
Sporting facilities abound, including Home Farm FC, Na Fianna GAA Club, and The Lawn Tennis Club. The Botanic Gardens, Corpus Christi Church, and a host of nearby parks and green spaces further enhance the area, offering residents ample opportunities for leisure, recreation, and connection with nature, all just moments from the doorstep.
Transport links are superb, with the M1 and M50 motorways nearby, multiple bus routes, Drumcondra Rail Station, Clontarf DART Station and newly upgraded cycle lanes for green commuting options. Dublin's international airport is just a short drive away.
